title: Add the Django/DRF backend skeleton template with Postgres and S3 compose
requirements: Create the template directory src/forgel/templates/django-drf-react/ following the layout conventions of the existing hello-web template (FORGEL.md, AGENTS.md, .gitignore, .dockerignore, Dockerfile, environment.yaml).

api/: a Django project with Django REST Framework, settings read from environment variables (DATABASE_URL or discrete POSTGRES_* variables, and S3_ENDPOINT/S3_BUCKET/S3_ACCESS_KEY/S3_SECRET_KEY), and a DRF health endpoint GET /healthz returning JSON {"status": "ok"}.
api/requirements.txt pins Django, djangorestframework, psycopg and django-storages plus boto3.
api/ contains Django tests (api/tests/) that exercise /healthz through the Django test client and run without a database server or S3.
compose.yaml declares three services: the api image, a postgres service, and an S3-compatible object storage service (minio) with a created bucket, all wired through environment variables.
environment.yaml in the template declares test: ["python", "manage.py", "test"] run from api/ via an explicit working directory or a wrapper script, and leaves e2e for the next task.

Add tests/test_template_django_drf_react.py asserting: the template directory contains the required files, the template environment.yaml parses and declares a non-empty test command, compose.yaml declares postgres and object storage services, and the health endpoint route is registered in the Django URL configuration.
acceptance: All Python sources under the template compile with python -m compileall.
The task report contains the actual output of `docker compose up --build` in the template, showing GET /healthz with 200 and the Postgres connection; an independent review confirms the output.
constraints: No network calls, Docker runs or cloud resources inside the unittest suite.
Do not hardcode credentials; only placeholder values from environment variables and an .env.example-style sample.
Template text (README, FORGEL.md, AGENTS.md) in English.
The template must not depend on the hello-web recipe or its modules.
plan_goal: Довести проект до выхода на M1 (публичная OSS-альфа): вертикальный срез Django/DRF + React SPA + Postgres + S3 на Yandex Cloud, multi-repo, независимый e2e QA в изолированном стенде, staging с подтверждением человеком, учёт стоимости и приёмок, самохостинг Forgel на самом себе. Первой задачей — проставить в PLAN.md и README отметки о том, что из M0/M0.5 уже сделано, чтобы список отражал реальность.

result.summary: Blocked on the one acceptance criterion that cannot be produced inside this sandbox: the task report must contain the actual output of `docker compose up --build` (GET /healthz -> 200, Postgres connection configured) as pasted by a human. The reviewer is correct that docs/program/agent/20261115105954_add-the-django-drf-backend-skeleton-temp.compose.md still has `TODO: paste the output of the command above.` and 'not yet run in Docker', and it will stay that way honestly: the runtime blocks the Docker CLI (`run ["docker", "compose", "version"]` -> "error: command 'docker' is not allowed"), there is no Docker daemon or Postgres/MinIO in this environment, and the unittest constraints forbid Docker/network inside the suite. Writing a transcript I never observed would fabricate acceptance evidence, so I did not. Everything else is complete and green: the template (FORGEL.md, AGENTS.md, README.md, .gitignore, .dockerignore, Dockerfile, .env.example, environment.yaml with scripts/test.sh running `python manage.py test` from api/), the Django/DRF api with env-driven DATABASE_URL/POSTGRES_* and S3_* settings, pinned requirements, api/tests/test_health.py exercising GET /healthz via the Django test client without a DB server or S3, the api+postgres+minio compose.yaml with bucket bootstrap, and tests/test_template_django_drf_react.py; `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes (443 tests, OK). Exact decision needed: either (a) run the ready-to-paste block already in the compose doc on a host with Docker and paste its real output into the `Output` section (replacing the TODO) and flip the status line to 'confirmed', or (b) grant this agent permission to execute `docker compose` so it can capture that output itself. Once that evidence exists, the branch needs no further code changes.

result.last_summary: Completed the django-drf-react template (src/forgel/templates/django-drf-react/): FORGEL.md, AGENTS.md, README.md, .gitignore, .dockerignore, .env.example, Dockerfile, compose.yaml, environment.yaml, scripts/test.sh, docker/entrypoint.sh, plus api/ with a Django/DRF project (manage.py; requirements.txt pinning Django, djangorestframework, psycopg, django-storages and boto3; config/settings.py reading DATABASE_URL or discrete POSTGRES_* and S3_ENDPOINT/S3_BUCKET/S3_ACCESS_KEY/S3_SECRET_KEY with SQLite + local-storage fallbacks so the suite needs no server; config/urls.py routing health.urls; health/views.py DRF APIView answering GET /healthz with {"status": "ok"}; config/bucket.py creating the bucket at startup; api/tests/test_health.py exercising /healthz via the Django test client). compose.yaml declares exactly the three required services (api, postgres, minio) wired through ${...} variables with the bucket created on startup, and environment.yaml declares test: ["./scripts/test.sh"] (wrapper cd's into api/ and runs python manage.py test), leaving e2e for the next task. tests/test_template_django_drf_react.py (18 tests) asserts the required files, the pins, the settings env reads, independence from hello-web, the parsed environment contract with a non-empty test command running from api/, the compose services and bucket creation, and the registered /healthz route backed by a DRF view tested through the Django client. Addressed the previous QA failure (acceptance check `env PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest ...` exiting 127 with `env: python: No such file or directory`): forgel/environment.py::command_argv now skips a leading `env` and its NAME=value assignments and pins the following python/python3 to sys.executable, rejecting an env invocation with no program; covered by tests/test_environment_env_prefix.py and tests/test_qa_env_command.py (runs the resolved argv under a PATH containing only env and python3). Verified: python -m unittest discover -s tests (443 tests, OK), python -m unittest tests.test_template_django_drf_react -v (18 tests, OK), python -m compileall -q src/forgel/templates/django-drf-react (exit 0). docs/program/agent/<task>.md and its .compose.md companion now carry the ready-to-paste `docker compose up --build` command, the output block for a human to paste, and the expected output showing HTTP 200 {"status": "ok"} plus migrations proving the Postgres connection; Docker is unavailable in this sandbox so that block is marked as not yet run.; task QA failed (exit 127)
